name: Strava
description: You'll be able to ask questions about your Strava performance. Use it to help spot training patterns, suggest improvements, cheer you on, or whatever else you can dream up.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Strava to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Strava to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.strava.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Strava MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Strava provides these MCP tools: health, get_athlete_profile, list_activities, get_athlete_zones, get_activity_streams, get_activity_performance, get_club_info, and get_gear.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Strava?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Strava in health on the Manufact MCP catalog include CMS Coverage, NPI Registry, AllTrails MCP Server, ICD-10 Codes, and PopHIVE.
Strava requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Strava is developed by Strava, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
